items.title: Humans are better at coding than AI
items.raw_excerpt: A new study suggests that while AI has advanced in code generation, humans still outperform it in complex programming tasks, especially in understanding requirements, debugging, and creative problem-solving. The study found that AI-generated code is efficient for simple scenarios but falls short in handling edge cases and logical errors compared to human programmers.

title_i18n.en: Humans are better at coding than AI
title_i18n.zh: 人类在编程方面比AI更擅长。
title_i18n.es: Los humanos son mejores programando que la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: A new study suggests that while AI has advanced in code generation, humans still outperform it in complex programming tasks, especially in understanding requirements, debugging, and creative problem-solving. The study found that AI-generated code is efficient for simple scenarios but falls short in handling edge cases and logical errors compared to human programmers.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一项新研究指出，尽管AI在代码生成方面取得进展，但人类在复杂编程任务中仍具优势，特别是在理解需求、调试和创造性解决问题方面。该研究通过对比实验发现，AI生成的代码在简单场景下效率高，但在处理边缘情况和逻辑错误时表现不如人类程序员。

items.title: Semble – Code search for agents that uses 98% fewer tokens than grep
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN! We (Stephan and Thomas) recently open-sourced Semble. We kept running into the same problem while using Claude Code on large codebases: when the agent can't find something directly, it falls back to grep, reading full files or launching subagents. This uses a lot of tokens, and often still misses the relevant code. There are existing tools for this, but they were either too slow to index on demand, needed API keys, or had poor retrieval quality. Semble is our solution for this. It combines static Model2Vec embeddings (using our latest static model: potion-code-16M) with BM25, fused via RRF and reranked with code-aware signals.
